description: This is a PHP source file defining the CandidateActionController class within the OrangeHRM Recruitment plugin. The class handles pre-render logic for candidate-related actions, including retrieving candidate data, selecting appropriate components based on actions, and setting component properties for rendering.

classes.name: CandidateActionController
classes.description: Controller class for handling candidate action pre-render logic in the recruitment module, extending AbstractVueController.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component based on the candidate ID and action selected, throwing exceptions if candidate not found or action invalid. It sets up the appropriate Vue component and properties for rendering.
